'''Alderaanian style''' was a distinct style of architecture from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Orowood Tower]] was built in the style.<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] was also heavily inspired by Alderaanian architecture.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
